# VIVI CITY

> > VIVI CITY is a travel platform offering skip-the-line tickets, guided tours, and destination guides for major attractions worldwide.

The site combines a booking platform for tickets and tours with a comprehensive travel blog featuring destination guides for European and global attractions. Content focuses on major tourist sites including the Colosseum, Pompeii, Schönbrunn Palace, Machu Picchu, and attractions across Italy, Austria, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Skip-the-line tickets
- Guided tours
- Italy travel (Rome, Pompeii, Amalfi Coast, Naples)
- Vienna attractions (Schönbrunn Palace, Hofburg, Belvedere Museum)
- Archaeological sites
- European destinations
- Historical sites
- Colosseum
- Machu Picchu
- Austrian tourism
- Travel guides
- World attractions
- Tourist booking platform
- Destination planning

## Platform Overview

- [VIVI CITY: Find and book Skip-The-Line tickets and tours - Home2](https://www.vivi.city/): Main homepage for skip-the-line ticket booking & tour comparison platform
- [VIVI CITY Travel Blog - Enjoy your travel](https://enjoy.vivi.city/en/): Travel blog homepage featuring tips for destinations worldwide

## Vienna & Austria Travel Guides

- [Belvedere, Schönbrunn, Hofburg and other attraction to see in Vienna](https://enjoy.vivi.city/en/travel-tips/things-to-do-in-vienna.html): Vienna attractions guide: Schönbrunn, Hofburg, Belvedere & Bratislava trips

## Italy & Mediterranean Destinations

- [Visit Pompeii Ruins - Tickets, opening hours and guided tours](https://enjoy.vivi.city/en/travel-tips/visit-pompeii-ruins.html): Pompeii Ruins visitor guide with tickets, tours & Naples day trip info
- [Visit Paestum (Italy): Ruins, greek temples and Cilento beaches](https://enjoy.vivi.city/en/travel-tips/paestum-temples-a-plunge-in-ancient-greece-a-step-away-from-the-amalfi-coast.html): Paestum Greek temples guide with tours from Naples & Amalfi Coast
